title: HVAC Advertising: Getting More Service Calls (2026)

facts.fact: The page says the U.S. HVAC industry generates roughly $31 billion in annual revenue, citing IBISWorld, a third-party source.
facts.quote: The HVAC industry in the U.S. generates roughly [$31 billion in annual revenue]

facts.fact: The page cites the Bureau of Labor Statistics as projecting 6% job growth for HVAC mechanics through 2032.
facts.quote: The Bureau of Labor Statistics projects [6% job growth for HVAC mechanics]

facts.fact: A 2024 BrightLocal survey, as cited by the page, found that 76% of consumers say they "regularly" read online reviews when choosing a local business.
facts.quote: 76% of consumers say they "regularly" read online reviews when choosing a local business

facts.fact: The page states that for most HVAC markets, Google Local Services Ads fees run about $25 to $75 per inquiry, charged when a homeowner calls or messages.
facts.quote: For most HVAC markets, LSA fees run about $25 to $75 per inquiry.

facts.fact: The page cites WordStream's 2024 search benchmarks as putting average cost per click for HVAC terms around $15 to $40.
facts.quote: put average cost per click for HVAC terms around $15 to $40

facts.fact: The page gives a planning range of $1,500 to $5,000 per month for combined Local Services Ads and search spend, described as media budget rather than booked jobs.
facts.quote: $1,500 to $5,000 per month is a planning range for combined LSA and search spend.

facts.fact: In WordStream's 2026 Facebook benchmarks, the Home and Home Improvement category shows a median cost per click of $2.18, a third-party figure that is not HVAC-specific.
facts.quote: a median $2.18 per click and $42.95 per lead on leads campaigns

facts.fact: In WordStream's 2026 Facebook benchmarks, the Home and Home Improvement category shows a median cost per lead of $42.95 on leads campaigns, based on at least four U.S. campaigns from April 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026.
facts.quote: from a sample of at least four U.S. campaigns in that category between April 1, 2025, and June 30, 2026

facts.fact: The page cites Sprout Social's 2024 benchmarks as showing short-form video gets 2.5 times more engagement than static images on Meta platforms.
facts.quote: short-form video gets 2.5 times more engagement than static images on Meta platforms

facts.fact: The page was published on October 5, 2026.
